answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in nectar, expire in tundra, and ember lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 94 aliases therefore needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 49 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
